claims.text: The public submission surface is the Plugins dashboard at platform.openai.com/plugins, whose steps are "Upload your plugin ZIP", "Complete automated checks", "Submit for review" and "Publish your plugin".

Identity verification is mandatory before submission: "All plugin submissions must come from verified individuals or organizations" and "Publishing under an unverified individual or business name will result in rejection."

The signed-in organization holds no verification: the Individual row still says "You are verifying as a solo developer." beside a Start button, and the flow opens "Start ID Check" with an identity check using our partner Persona.
For an MCP-backed listing "all four listing URLs are required": websiteURL, supportURL, privacyPolicyURL and termsOfServiceURL.
Review needs "exactly five positive and three negative cases", a reviewer-accessible demo recording URL, and reviewer credentials if sign-in is required.
PayStage already meets the privacy-policy field: https://paystage.xyz/privacy states there are "no tracking cookies and no pixels" and enumerates recorded fields, recipients and removal.
Row 350 recorded "account + review, no money stated" and "gate: none", having read the catalogue rather than the submission portal.
